questions.stem: What must always be conserved in a nuclear equation?

options.text: The type of element on both sides
The total mass number and total atomic number

questions.explanation: In any nuclear equation, both the total mass number (top numbers) and the total atomic number (bottom numbers) must be the same on both sides. This reflects conservation of nucleon number and conservation of charge. The element itself can change, which is the whole point of nuclear decay.
